description: This file defines a Spark optimization rule 'DisableUnnecessaryBucketedScan' that disables bucketed table scans when they are unnecessary based on the physical query plan. It includes logic to analyze the plan's operators, distributions, and specific conditions to determine if a bucketed scan can be disabled to optimize query execution.

classes.name: DisableUnnecessaryBucketedScan
classes.description: A Spark optimization rule that disables unnecessary bucketed table scans based on the physical plan analysis.

methods.name: disableBucketWithInterestingPartition
methods.description: Recursively traverses the SparkPlan to disable bucketed scans when conditions are met, propagating flags about interesting partitions, exchanges, and allowed unary nodes.

methods.name: hasInterestingPartition
methods.description: Checks if the plan's required child distribution indicates an interesting partition, based on distribution types.

methods.name: isAllowedUnaryExecNode
methods.description: Determines if a SparkPlan node is an allowed unary operator (Sort, Project, Filter, or certain aggregates) for the purpose of disabling bucketed scans.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Entry point for the rule; applies the disabling logic if bucketing and auto-bucketed scan are enabled and a bucketed scan exists.
